name: Escape Office
steps: Use the wrench on the worker’s vest to open the duct.
Give the cardboard box to the employee.
Use the scissors on the portrait, then give the cutout face to the employee.
Use the scissors on the dog.
Give the poisonous mushroom to the security guard.
Give the red dress to the worker.
Tap and swipe the fan to set it to maximum speed.
Use the scissors on the electrical box.
Open the book and take the iron pickaxe.
Use the iron pickaxe on the crack in the floor.
Take the money from the employee’s pocket and give it to the security guard to complete the level.
